texts.label: text
texts.orig: As shown in Figure 1, geologists may use multiple data types to identify depositional environments, including core data, well logs, biostratigraphic data, sedimentological data, and seismic data. Each data source provides different insights and together help build a comprehensive understanding of the depositional setting. In our project, the initial focus will be on extracting information solely from well data. Well data, along with well tops and a suitable supporting database, will be used to identify both the gross depositional environment and its subcategories. This approach leverages well logs and associated stratigraphic markers to interpret sedimentary facies and depositional processes effectively.
